answer_2.quote: We define comprehensive accuracy as: measuring whether model predictions are both accurate and self-consistent across perturbations.

answer_4.quote: we sample 100 question pairs (200 questions) from each question type for the 6 tests and procure 5 annotations per question from workers on Amazon Mechanical Turk.
answer_4.guideline: Each HIT include 24 questions total, including 4 verification questions, and typically include a variety of question types from each of our tests. Workers are vetted for a 97% approval rating and minimum of 500 completed HITs.
